english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[interfered with]_
(B)_[moved]_
(C)_[removed]_

apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), which related to the

(D)_[construction]_
(E)_[maintenance]_

of major transport works, namely **(..SPECIFY WORKS..), at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) and belonged to

english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(1)(b) and (3) of the Public Order Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and locationinterfered with / moved / removed
any apparatus relating to the construction / maintenance of major transport works and belonging to the undertaker / person acting under the authority of the undertaker / statutory undertaker / person acting under the authority of a statutory undertaker

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A person charged with this offence will have a defence where they had a reasonable excuse for the act or, where the act of interference/movement or removal was done wholly or mainly in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute (section 6(2)).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum term of imprisonment for summary offences and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
The maximum term for summary offences is 6 months where the offence is committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 is in force. Where an offence is committed after section 281(5) is in force, the maximum term is 51 weeks.
